summary_en: FY2027 dividend per share raised to 152 yen (split-adjusted basis) from 146 yen forecast, reflecting upgraded earnings outlook. Full-year operating profit lifted 5.0% to 17.7 billion yen on higher construction progress and improved project profitability.
title_en: Notification of Revisions to Full-Year Earnings Forecasts and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase) for FY2027
translation_en_brief:
Raito Kogyo revised its FY2027 dividend forecast upward to 152 yen per share (split-adjusted basis) from the previously announced 146 yen, representing a 6-yen increase on a pre-split basis. The dividend increase reflects an upgraded earnings outlook, with full-year consolidated operating profit now forecast at 17.7 billion yen, up 5.0% from the previous forecast of 16.85 billion yen. The company attributed the earnings improvement to progress on construction projects exceeding initial expectations and enhanced project profitability.

The dividend revision aligns with Raito Kogyo's medium-term management plan "Raito 2027," which targets a total shareholder return ratio of approximately 100% during the plan period. The company intends to maintain a progressive dividend policy while pursuing a payout ratio of 50% or higher and achieving a return on equity (DOE) of 6% or higher by the final fiscal year (FY2027). The company continues to advance its capital efficiency improvement and optimal capital structure initiatives to support sustainable growth.
